bound_inputs: seed442 initializer, A/B endpoints, registration, step-tensors.npz, trajectory receipts and compressed replay snapshots

order: if D>0 and S>=0.75D for both weightings: first_order_value_harm_dominant
else if D>0 and R>=0.75D for both weightings: finite_step_value_residual_dominant

interpretation: descriptive retrospective attribution, not causal interventions or prospective outcome evidence; residual includes nonlinear and numerical effects and is not pure curvature; authorizes no training, gate change, or strength claim

objectives.value_mse: mean squared prediction error; no training coefficient

population: unseen >32; 2,607 exposure rows and 1,242 exact-input identities
primary_objective: unseen value MSE, unweighted by training coefficient
reference: A and policy CE descriptive only
step: float64 difference of adjacent archived float32 accepted states; gradient at pre-state; d=post-pre objective; s=gradient dot displacement; r=d-s
temporal_scope: retrospective attribution; endpoint outcomes and failed gates already known

weightings.equal_input: within-identity exposure mean then identities equal mass
